prompts.title: Casual White Shirt Man Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly for accurate face/identity matching. Preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure of the reference person.
Create a photorealistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of a handsome man sitting beside a large wooden-framed window in a cozy, elegant interior. He has soft, naturally styled hair, refined facial features, clear natural skin, and a calm, thoughtful expression. His head is turned slightly toward the window as he gazes outside, with a relaxed, introspective mood.
He is wearing a loose, oversized white cotton button-up shirt, with the top buttons casually undone, revealing part of his upper chest. The shirt has natural wrinkles and soft fabric texture. He sits in a relaxed pose, with his left arm resting casually on the window ledge and his hand hanging naturally, while his other arm rests comfortably by his side.
Warm golden-hour sunlight streams through the window from the left, softly illuminating his face, hair, neck, and white shirt while creating beautiful natural highlights and gentle shadows. The background features a warm, sophisticated interior with subtle framed artwork and dark furniture, kept softly out of focus. Outside the window, lush green foliage appears as creamy golden bokeh.
Composition: vertical 4:5 portrait, medium/upper-body framing, subject positioned centered, eye-level camera angle, natural candid pose, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh.
Photography: 85mm lens, f/1.8, soft cinematic depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural color grading, warm golden tones, subtle filmic contrast, soft atmospheric glow, premium editorial photography, highly detailed, ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, 8K quality. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Aesthetic Sad Boy Rain Photo Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly realistic, premium 8K cinematic full-body portrait using the uploaded reference photo as the identity reference. Preserve the subject’s exact facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, grooming, beard details, and natural appearance. Do not alter, beautify, or stylize the face unnaturally.
Recreate the scene with the same overall composition, camera angle, pose, environment, lighting, mood, perspective, and framing as the reference image.

Subject & Pose
A young man is seated naturally on a classic dark wooden bench with black metal supports in a city park during a rainy evening. Position him slightly toward the right side of the frame.
He sits in a relaxed, thoughtful posture with his upper body upright but comfortable. Both hands rest naturally near his lap, with one hand gently placed over the other. His legs are naturally spaced apart, with both feet firmly planted on the wet pavement.
His head is slightly raised and turned to the side as he looks upward toward the rainy sky. His expression should feel calm, introspective, slightly emotional, and natural, without exaggerated posing.

Outfit
Dress him in:

Premium light-gray oversized casual jacket/shacket with realistic fabric texture
Simple black crew-neck T-shirt
Fitted black trousers
Clean, minimal white low-top sneakers
Render realistic fabric folds, stitching, seams, wrinkles, thickness, and natural clothing proportions.

Environment
Set the scene in a beautiful, atmospheric urban park during rainfall.
Place a tall vintage black street lamp on the LEFT side of the frame, featuring an elegant classic lantern design with a warm yellow-orange glow. The lamp should provide a subtle warm visual contrast against the cool blue-gray rainy environment.
The background should include a dark cloudy blue-gray overcast sky, soft mist, blurred trees, distant park scenery, and subtle warm bokeh lights. Keep the background strongly defocused with cinematic depth of field while retaining enough recognizable detail to establish the park setting.

Rain & Ground
Show fine, natural rain streaks throughout the scene with a convincing wet atmosphere. Add subtle water droplets and moisture to the subject’s clothing, bench, and surroundings.
The pavement must appear wet and reflective, with shallow puddles naturally reflecting the glowing street lamp and distant ambient lights. Include scattered wet autumn leaves, especially across the foreground.

Composition
Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio
Full-body seated portrait
Subject positioned slightly right of center
Street lamp clearly visible on the left
Generous negative space above the subject
Cinematic low-to-medium camera angle
Natural perspective and realistic scale
Balanced visual separation between the subject and street lamp
Match the reference image’s composition and framing as closely as possible
Lighting & Color
Use dramatic yet natural cinematic rainy-evening lighting. Combine cool, desaturated blue-gray ambient light with the warm golden-orange illumination from the street lamp.
Use soft directional light across the face, subtle rim lighting around the subject, realistic shadows, controlled highlights, moderate contrast, and sophisticated cinematic color grading.
Avoid excessive orange tones, crushed shadows, artificial HDR, or overly dramatic AI-style lighting.

Camera & Photorealism
Professional full-frame DSLR/mirrorless photography, 50mm lens look, realistic optical depth of field, tack-sharp focus on the subject and face, softly blurred foreground and background, and natural optical bokeh.
Preserve:

Realistic skin pores and natural skin texture
Individual hair strands
Detailed beard and grooming texture
Accurate fabric fibers
Natural hands and fingers
Realistic feet and footwear
Correct anatomy and body proportions
Physically realistic reflections, shadows, rain, and wet surfaces
The final result should look like a luxury fashion/editorial photograph captured by a professional photographer on a rainy evening — photorealistic, cinematic, sophisticated, atmospheric, natural, emotionally subtle, and highly detailed.
No artificial AI appearance, plastic skin, facial distortion, incorrect anatomy, malformed hands, unnatural body proportions, excessive smoothing, fake reflections, or exaggerated cinematic effects.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: Unspoken Words
prompts.prompt:
Composition & Layout:
A vertically stacked three-frame cinematic triptych (top → middle → bottom), perfectly aligned with equal width and seamless transitions between panels.
NO borders, NO gaps, NO dividers — the three panels must appear as one continuous stacked composition.
Each panel represents a different crop of the SAME subject, SAME environment, SAME lighting conditions, and SAME moment in time.
Final output aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical.
Environment & Background:
A vast open dry golden field stretching toward a soft horizon with distant rolling hills.
Sky features a warm sunset gradient—soft orange, peach, and subtle pink tones blending into muted twilight.
No buildings, no modern elements, no extra people. Pure natural landscape.
Background remains consistent across all panels (only depth of field changes).
Lighting:
Golden hour lighting with the sun positioned low near the horizon.
Soft cinematic backlight combined with subtle front fill to avoid underexposure on face and outfit.
Warm tones, diffused light, gentle highlights on hair and skin.
No harsh shadows, no overexposure, no lighting inconsistency across panels.
Outfit & Styling:
Maroon/burgundy textured jacket (corduroy-like), worn open over an off-white/cream t-shirt.
Minimal silver chain necklace visible.
Natural fabric texture clearly visible—fine details, no unrealistic shine.
Accessories: subtle silver ring.
Hair slightly messy, natural movement—no over-styling.
Panel Breakdown
Panel 1 (Top – Wide / Medium Shot):
Framing: Chest-up to mid-torso shot with environmental context visible
Pose: Subject turned slightly away from camera, head tilted looking toward the horizon (off-frame sun)
Expression: Calm, contemplative, thoughtful
Composition: Subject centered, maintaining cinematic negative space
Background: Clear view of field and distant hills
Panel 2 (Middle – Medium Close Shot):
Framing: Tight waist-up / chest-up portrait
Pose: Head tilted downward, Right hand running through hair naturally
Expression: Introspective, slightly emotional, grounded
Detail: Ring visible on fingers, natural hand tension
Focus: Balanced between face, hand, and outfit texture
Panel 3 (Bottom – Tight Close-Up Profile):
Framing: Close-up side profile
Pose: Subject looking downward/right, holding a small dried flower delicately near face
Expression: Quiet, reflective, intimate mood
Depth of Field: Very shallow (strong background blur)
Focus: Sharp on face + object, soft cinematic bokeh in background
Camera & Technical Details:
Camera: Full-frame mirrorless (Canon EOS R5 / Sony A7R V equivalent)
Lens: 35mm for top panel, 50mm feel for middle, ~85mm close-up compression for bottom
Aperture: f/2.0 – f/2.8 (shallow depth of field progression)
ISO: 100–200
Shutter: ~1/400 – 1/800
Ultra-sharp focus on subject, natural falloff in background
Color & Style:
Cinematic, film-like color grading
Warm earthy palette: maroon, golden yellow, amber, soft orange, muted sky tones
Subtle natural grain (not heavy)
High dynamic range but soft contrast (no harsh clipping)
Strict Rules:
SAME face, SAME background, SAME lighting across all panels
ONLY change: framing + pose + crop
No extra subjects
No artificial effects, no over-stylization
Maintain realism, texture, and natural imperfections

prompts.title: Keyhole Perspective
prompts.prompt:
Create a cinematic, ultra-realistic portrait of a man seated on a vintage brown leather armchair.
Identity Preservation (VERY IMPORTANT)

Use the provided reference image to strictly match the subject’s identity. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, age, hairline, and hairstyle.

No beautification, no stylization, no identity drift.
Concept & Framing

The scene is viewed through a foreground keyhole-shaped frame, creating a voyeuristic, storytelling perspective.
The keyhole is large and close to the camera, occupying the foreground
It is clearly a keyhole shape (rounded top + tapered bottom)
NOT circular, NOT oval, NOT vignette
Slightly organic, subtly asymmetrical edges
Material & Look of Keyhole

Warm brown tone (wood)
Matte surface with soft texture
Inner rim catches warm golden light, creating a subtle glow
Entire keyhole is out of focus (foreground blur heavily)

Man seated centrally on a vintage brown leather sofa chair
Wearing a dark charcoal pinstripe suit, crisp white shirt, and a dark, low-contrast textured tie
Slim, structured tailoring (modern luxury fit)
Pose Details (IMPORTANT)

Upright posture, slightly leaning forward
Both hands clasped together
Fingers interlocked
Hands positioned near knees
Expression: calm, focused, slightly intense
Direct eye contact with camera
Lighting (CRITICAL FOR RESULT)

Single industrial pendant lamp hanging directly above
Warm golden spotlight shining downward
Creates:
Soft highlight on head and shoulders
Deep cinematic shadows on face sides and chair
Smooth light falloff
High contrast but natural (film noir style, not harsh artificial)
Environment / Background

Dark minimalist interior wall
Deep charcoal matte finish
Subtle panel molding (very low contrast, not distracting)
Color Palette

Warm amber tones, deep browns, soft blacks

→ Maintain a muted luxury editorial tone (NOT overly saturated)
Depth & Cinematic Feel

Strong shallow depth of field
Keyhole foreground = blurred
Subject = sharp focus
Slight atmospheric haze for cinematic richness
Strong subject isolation
Composition

4:5 vertical
Perfectly centered and symmetrical
Subject aligned directly under the hanging light
Balanced, editorial framing
Style Keywords

cinematic lighting, film noir, luxury editorial portrait, moody atmosphere, dramatic shadows, warm glow, storytelling composition, keyhole perspective, ultra-realistic

85mm lens, f/1.8, ISO 100–200

Ultra-sharp focus on face

prompts.title: Frayed Reality
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo as a strict identity reference.

The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, jawline, lips, hairline, and hairstyle must remain exactly identical.

This is one single continuous face (not two people, no duplication).

The face must NOT change across sections. Only rendering style and emotion change.
Main Concept
Create a 4:5 ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait with DSLR realism, 8K detail, natural skin texture, and shallow depth of field.

Concept: public persona vs hidden emotion revealed through a torn paper strip.
Composition (STRICT GEOMETRY)
Vertical 4:5 portrait
Subject perfectly centered
Face straight, no tilt, direct eye contact
Symmetrical alignment across the vertical axis
Subject Framing (IMPORTANT)
Head-and-shoulders portrait (tight crop)

Bottom crop: mid-chest level (turtleneck fully visible)
Subject occupies ~70–80% of frame height
Very little empty space on sides (clean editorial framing)
Background
Dark cinematic seamless studio background
Smooth gradient:
Slight neutral gray behind the head (center)
Fades to deep black toward edges and corners
Subtle vignette effect
No texture, no color cast, no patterns
Torn Paper Layout (CRITICAL)
Create ONE horizontal torn-paper strip across the eyes:

Position: exactly across the eye region (mid-face only)
Thickness: ~20–25% of face height
Edges: rough, fibrous, uneven
Right side: slightly rolled/curling paper edge (visible depth)
Realistic paper thickness + soft shadow
⚠️ Must look like the top layer is torn and the inner layer revealed

⚠️ No duplication of face
Base Layer (Full Image — Public Persona)
Full color
Warm, natural skin tones
Visible red lipstick (clean, defined)
Subtle, confident, closed-mouth smile
Hair:

Natural flow toward the shoulders

Soft visible fabric texture (subtle knit detail)
Lighting:

Soft cinematic studio lighting
Gentle highlights + soft shadows
Skin texture preserved (no smoothing)
Inside Torn Paper (ONLY inside strip — Hidden Emotion)
Pure black-and-white (strict monochrome)
Same face, perfectly aligned
Expression:

Emotionally vulnerable, slightly tense
Tear (MANDATORY — DO NOT MISS)
Two clearly visible tear streams (one under each eye)
Sharp, reflective, well-defined
Catching light (specular highlights)
Not faint, not blurred
Lighting:

Slightly higher contrast
More shadow depth around the eyes
Realism Enforcement
Photorealistic DSLR output
Visible pores and natural skin texture
Hair strands are individually defined
Tear reflections crisp and sharp
Paper edges detailed with depth and shadow
Hard Constraints
One face only
Perfect alignment across layers
No facial distortion
Tear must be clearly visible
Hair is consistent across layers
No stylization
Negative Prompt

No duplicated face

No vertical split

No misaligned layers

prompts.title: The Unsent Bouquet
prompts.prompt:
MASTER STRUCTURE & IDENTITY (TOP PRIORITY): A vertical cinematic triptych (three stacked panels within a 2:3 aspect ratio frame). Strict facial identity, hairstyle, and physique matching across all panels based on the reference image.
ATMOSPHERE & TECHNICAL SPECS: Arthouse film still aesthetic during blue hour (dusk) on a deserted ocean beach. Deeply melancholic and introspective mood. Cool, desaturated color palette dominated by ocean blues and muted whites. Ultra-photorealistic 4K quality with fine Kodak Portra 400 film grain, atmospheric haze, and soft natural contrast.
SUBJECT BASE: Solitary man with wind-tousled natural hair and light stubble, wearing a slightly wrinkled white linen button-down shirt, moving in the sea breeze.
PANEL 1 (TOP - WIDE REAR): 35mm lens, straight half-body directly facing the horizon of the middle of the sea. Emphasize solitude, wet reflective sand, and faint mist over heavy twilight waves.
PANEL 2 (MIDDLE - MEDIUM PROFILE): 35mm lens, three-quarter profile facing left, standing on wet sand. Holding a bouquet of white roses and hydrangea, looking down with a sombre expression. Natural side-lighting creates gentle modelling.
PANEL 3 (BOTTOM - CLOSE-UP): 85mm portrait lens (f/1.8 shallow DOF), tight close-up facing slightly right, looking off-camera with sorrowful eyes. Extreme focus on wind-blown hair strands, epidermal texture, pores, and damp skin under soft diffused light against smooth ocean bokeh.
